My fruit trees and coffee bushes have been on this land for many years, so I do not need to buy seed. I will put manure from my oxen and sheep around the plants, but I will save any chemical fertilizer I can get from the cooperative for my maize and teff plots instead. My family will do all the work—weeding, pruning, and picking—because I cannot afford to pay workers, and I do not use chemicals since they cost too much and I do not know how to use them safely.
